event.description: Use tanh-approximated GELU with one FF-output scalar union
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 19 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0022 at 3,040 parameters/99.85%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0137, whose SiLU plus output union 82/85 scored 0.01% at 1,671 parameters. Hypothesis: the failure was caused by changing to SiLU's qualitatively different gate, while the standard tanh approximation to GELU preserves the incumbent activation shape closely enough to absorb the same minimum-difference output union. Keep width 16, change only exact GELU to its tanh approximation, union coordinates 82/85, and yield 1,671 parameters. This is more informative than ReLU because it is the nearest functional activation alternative and cleanly tests curve-level robustness under identical compression.
